policy: Each evidenced historical BAFTA category page must be mapped to one named current included category, with an explicit target programme when the category moved between BAFTA programmes, or explicitly excluded from this current-lineage milestone. Similar wording and adjacent years are not sufficient to merge distinct first-party pages.
